content.short: SIMEL connects companies and institutions to Cardano's blockchain network. The result is a better, faster and more cost-efficient trade.
content.description:
Today's global trade is complex and costly. Efficient coordination, security and reliable data are required for their proper operation.

Improving Global Trade & Supply Chains management and taking it to another level happens to be one of the best use cases of blockchain technology. At SIMEL, we want to create a platform for supply chains management that establishes trust between different actors, guarantees reliable and unalterable data and reduces costs. The result is a better, faster and more cost-efficient trade.
